About us

Turning your vision into your home

A Central Oregon builder bringing customer service and craftsmanship back to residential construction.

Connect with us

Our philosophy

Home building is more than just construction

After more than 20 years in the industry, we noticed a shift in priorities among many companies: profits began to outweigh customer satisfaction. Time and again, we've heard from clients at estimates, “We're so glad you showed up.”

That feedback reaffirmed our belief that a great company begins with its customers. Our mission is simple: we deliver high-end craftsmanship at an affordable price, always putting our clients first by holding to our five core values.

Five core values

What we stand for

Integrity

We do what we say we'll do, and we're honest about what your project needs.

Craftsmanship

Every job gets the same level of professionalism and care, whether it's big or small.

Transparency

Clear estimates, straight answers and regular updates from start to finish.

Innovation

Green building practices, reclaimed materials and smarter ways to stretch your budget.

Teamwork

Our crew, local subcontractors and local suppliers work as one team, with you at the center.
